claim: Pair the D18:eC9 B0 field-generation baseline with a Suns-Voc/pseudo-FF transport-loss discriminator so favorable TDCF or bias-dependent-PL behavior cannot be interpreted as sufficient evidence of charge collection or useful electrical work.
changed_evidentiary_state: Transport/collection moves from a required but unspecified conventional control to a preregistered, machine-checkable companion measurement. No D18 transport-loss acceptance threshold is created before real B0 data and instrument repeatability exist.

source_provenance.title: Applicability of the Suns-Voc Method on Organic Solar Cells
facts_used: Suns-Voc yields pseudo-JV characteristics intended to remove series-resistance effects and reflect generation/recombination
the method was experimentally applied to P3HT:PCBM organic solar cells
transient and capacitive effects are validity concerns that must be considered

source_provenance.title: Transport Resistance Dominates the Fill Factor Losses in Record Organic Solar Cells
facts_used: pFF minus measured FF is used as a transport-resistance FF-loss metric
J(Vimp) can be constructed from light-intensity-dependent Voc and generation-current data
low-light leakage, external series resistance, interpolation density, and generation-current estimation are explicit method concerns
source_provenance.scope_note: Used to specify the contemporary analysis workflow; the 2014 experimental paper remains the primary method precedent.

pairing_rule: Use the same device as the B0 TDCF/PL baseline when measurement order and device stability permit; otherwise use a preregistered sibling device on the same substrate and retain the mapping.
raw_provenance_required: illuminated JV trace used for measured FF/Pmax
light-intensity-dependent Voc data used for pseudo-JV construction
generation-current estimate versus light intensity and reverse-bias choice
pseudo-JV interpolation/reconstruction procedure and software version

transport_ff_loss.interpretation: descriptive FF loss associated with transport/series-resistance effects under the method assumptions; not a unique microscopic mechanism

ff_retention_relative_to_pseudo.interpretation: descriptive fraction of pseudo-FF retained in the measured JV curve

requirements_before_freeze: provenance-complete B0 illuminated-JV and Suns-Voc/pseudo-JV data
same-session repeatability or a documented session-transfer uncertainty
field-generation companion data retained for the same lot/device mapping
baseline_gate_freeze_rule.forbidden: Use the 7.8 percentage-point literature example or any cross-material value as a D18/PY-IT/eC9 pass/fail threshold.

predeclared_checks.domain: 0 < FF <= pFF <= 1 for an accepted summary row, allowing only the numerical tolerance; violations fail closed for transport classification and remain visible as method/QC failures
predeclared_checks.limiting_case: FF = pFF gives DeltaFF_tr = 0 and R_FF = 1
predeclared_checks.negative_control: pFF < FF beyond tolerance is not clamped; it is rejected as a method/data-consistency failure

serious_conventional_explanations: Suns-Voc/pseudo-JV mismatch caused by capacitive or transient response rather than steady-state transport loss
low-light leakage/shunt current corrupting Voc versus intensity
external electrode/contact series resistance contributing to pFF-FF alongside active-layer transport resistance
generation-current estimation error or intensity-calibration drift
device drift between field-generation, illuminated-JV, and Suns-Voc measurements
decision_rule: A B0 or later B1/B2 arm with favorable field-generation metrics but a materially degraded measured FF relative to its pseudo-FF remains transport/collection-limited and cannot be promoted to useful-work validation without stabilized Pmax and conventional-control resolution. The word materially is not assigned a numerical D18 threshold until real B0 repeatability is measured.
falsifier: If provenance-complete B0 data show pFF and FF are indistinguishable within empirical method repeatability across independent lots while stabilized Pmax is also robust, a large transport-resistance FF penalty is narrowed for the measured B0 regime; if pFF-FF is reproducibly positive, transport/collection remains a live downstream bottleneck even when field generation is favorable.
